thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - PrivateConnect customers in us-west-2 reporting intermittent failures -> DNS lookups intermittently NXDOMAIN and TLS stalls. Auto-page to oncall.

sara-oncall: I'm on it. Seeing spikes in connection resets to priv-serv.redwood.internal from multiple peering peers. Starting basic triage.

mike-netops: I can confirm increased BGP update churn from provider around 14:07 UTC. Peering session shows a flood of updates that correlate with the start of customer reports.

tess-sre: can someone run a quick repro from a bastion in us-west-2? paste dig + traceroute outputs here. We need to know if lookups are bouncing between ELB IPs.

sara-oncall: running now:

```
# from bastion-usw2b
$ dig +short priv-serv.redwood.internal @10.1.1.2
# sometimes returns 10.0.8.23, sometimes NXDOMAIN

$ sudo tcptraceroute 10.0.8.23 443
# path: usw2b -> provider-hop -> usw2a -> backend
# sometimes the path flips to usw2c mid-flow
```

sam-eng-runtime: runtime metrics show KV cache misses and TLS renegotiation spikes at the same timestamps. Mid-flow path switch is likely tearing sessions.

raj-eng-network: looking at reflector data: ECMP groups for our PrivateConnect prefixes were recomputed during the update burst. Hash buckets shifted, and some flows saw a different AZ next-hop halfway through.

mike-netops: provisional action: add a temporary route preference on our side to prefer next-hop 10.20.0.1 for the affected prefix 10.0.8.0/24. Doing gradual apply to avoid sudden cutover.

sara-oncall: please notify affected customers as soon as we have an ETA. Carmen can draft a short note with workaround steps (flush DNS, retry).

carmen-cs: drafted message ready for review: "We're investigating intermittent PrivateConnect connectivity in us-west-2. Workaround: flush DNS and retry requests. We'll update within 30m." @sara-oncall any edits?

sara-oncall: add that dedicated instances are unaffected and this is isolated to PrivateConnect peering. lgtm otherwise.

mike-netops: applied route preference on peer-router-1. Early telemetry: TCP retransmit rate for flows pinned through that router decreased by ~70%.

tess-sre: great. roll to remaining peers but monitor for any unexpected microbursts.

mike-netops: rolled to peer-router-2 and peer-router-3. Provider acknowledged and temporarily suppressed automated RIB refreshes for our session while we stabilize.

sara-oncall: monitoring dashboard: DNS errors trending down, backend 5xxs normalizing. One customer (cust-zenith) still reports errors.

carmen-cs: cust-zenith logs show TLS resets at 14:12 UTC and a flurry of NXDOMAINs. Sent them suggested steps and ETA 20m.

raj-eng-network: provider shared partial RIB snapshot. Extract:
```
prefix 10.0.8.0/24 next-hops [10.20.0.1 10.20.0.2 10.20.0.3] (ECMP)
# observed ~1200 updates in 6 minutes
```

tess-sre: confirms hypothesis. Action plan: keep preference pinned for 3 hours, request full RIB delta from provider, and prepare controlled re-enable of ECMP with increased hashing stability checks.

oncall-liz: I'll be taking the overnight shift in 40m. Anything I should keep an eye on?

sara-oncall: monitor BGP update rate (>200/5m) and cust-zenith recovery. If churn resumes, re-pin and escalate to provider support with RIB snapshots.

mike-netops: set alert for >200 BGP updates per 5m and >5% TCP retransmit increase. Also collecting tcpdump snippets from affected peers for later analysis.

carmen-cs: cust-zenith confirmed recovery at 14:34 UTC after applying the DNS retry and we told them we pinned routes; they're asking for a root cause timeline.

sara-oncall: marking incident mitigated after 2h of stability and no new BGP churn. We'll keep the temporary preference until morning for a controlled test.

tess-sre: assigning postmortem to raj-eng-network and mike-netops. Include timeline, RIB delta, cust impact, runbook updates for PrivateConnect pinning. Draft due in 48h.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS UPDATE - mitigated -> downgraded to P2. Link to internal doc /internal/incidents/1816007890. Participants: incident-bot, sara-oncall, mike-netops, tess-sre, sam-eng-runtime, carmen-cs, raj-eng-network, oncall-liz

oncall-liz: leaving handoff note in the incident doc and will monitor overnight. If provider shares full RIB deltas or root cause, we'll notify customers with an RCA.

sara-oncall: thanks all. follow-ups: request full RIB delta from provider, schedule controlled ECMP re-enable with gradual hashing, update PrivateConnect runbook. Closing thread.
